1.text: Nuko Umwami Yesu amenya yuko Abafarisayo bumvise ko yigisha kandi abatiza benshi, arusha Yohana,

2.text: (icyakora Yesu ubwe si we wabatizaga, ahubwo ni abigishwa be),

3.text: ni cyo cyatumye ava i Yudaya agasubira i Galilaya,

4.text: yiyumvamo ko akwiriye kunyura i Samariya.

5.text: Nuko agera mu mudugudu w'i Samariya witwa Sukara, bugufi bw'igikingi Yakobo yahaye umwana we Yosefu,

6.text: kandi aho hari iriba rya Yakobo. Nuko Yesu ananijwe n'uko yagenze cyane apfa kwicara kuri iryo riba, hari nk'isaha esheshatu.

7.text: Umusamariyakazi aza kuvoma, Yesu aramubwira ati “Mpa utuzi two kunywa”,

8.text: (kuko abigishwa be bari bagiye mu mudugudu kugura ibyo kurya.)

9.text: Umusamariyakazi aramusubiza ati “Ko uri Umuyuda nkaba Umusamariyakazi, uransaba amazi ute?” Icyatumye abaza atyo ni uko Abayuda banenaga Abasamariya.

10.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Iyaba wari uzi impano y'Imana, ukamenya n'ugusabye amazi uwo ari we, nawe uba umusabye na we akaguha amazi y'ubugingo.”

11.text: Undi ati “Databuja, ko udafite icyo uvomesha n'iriba rikaba ari rirerire, none se ayo mazi y'ubugingo wayakura he?

12.text: Mbese ye uruta sogokuruza Yakobo wadufukuriye iri riba, kandi akaba yaranywaga amazi yaryo ubwe n'abana be n'amatungo ye?”

13.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Umuntu wese unywa aya mazi azongera kugira inyota,

14.text: ariko unywa amazi nzamuha ntazagira inyota rwose iteka ryose, ahubwo amazi nzamuha azamuhindukiramo isoko y'amazi adudubiza kugeza mu bugingo buhoraho.”

15.text: Umugore aramubwira ati “Databuja, mpa kuri ayo mazi ntazagira inyota, kandi ntazagaruka kuvoma hano kuko ari kure.”

16.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Genda uhamagare umugabo wawe maze ugaruke hano.”

17.text: Umugore aramusubiza ati “Nta mugabo mfite.”Yesu aramubwira ati “Uvuze ukuri yuko udafite umugabo,

18.text: kuko wari ufite abagabo batanu, n'uwo ufite ubu si uwawe. Ibyo byo ubivuze ukuri.”

19.text: Umugore aramubwira ati “Databuja, menye yuko uri umuhanuzi.

20.text: Ba sogokuruza bacu basengeraga kuri uyu musozi, namwe mukagira ngo i Yerusalemu ni ho hakwiriye gusengerwa.”

21.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati“Mugore, nyizera. Igihe kizaza, ubwo bazaba batagisengera Data kuri uyu musozi cyangwa i Yerusalemu.

22.text: Dore mwebweho musenga icyo mutazi, ariko twebwe dusenga ibyo tuzi kuko agakiza kava mu Bayuda.

23.text: Ariko igihe kiraje ndetse kirasohoye, ubwo abasenga by'ukuri basengera Data mu Mwuka no mu kuri, kuko Data ashaka ko bene abo ari bo bamusenga.

24.text: Imana ni Umwuka, n'abayisenga bakwiriye kuyisengera mu Mwuka no mu kuri.”

25.text: Umugore aramubwira ati “Nzi yuko Mesiya azaza, ari we witwa Kristo, kandi ubwo azaza azatubwira byose.”

27.text: Uwo mwanya abigishwa be baraza batangazwa n'uko avugana n'uwo mugore, ariko ntihagira umubaza ati “Urashaka iki?” Cyangwa ati “Ni iki gitumye uvugana na we?”

28.text: Nuko uwo mugore asiga ikibindi cye, aragenda ajya mu mudugudu abwira abantu ati

29.text: “Nimuze murebe umuntu umbwiye ibyo nakoze byose, murebe ahari ko ari Kristo!”

30.text: Bava mu mudugudu ngo baze aho ari.

31.text: Batarahagera abigishwa be baramwinginga bati “Mwigisha, akira ufungure.”

33.text: Abigishwa be barabazanya bati “Mbese hari uwamuzaniye ibyokurya?”

34.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Ibyokurya byanjye ni ugukora ibyo uwantumye ashaka, no kurangiza umurimo we.

35.text: Mbese ntimuvuga ngo ‘Hasigaye amezi ane isarura rigasohora?’ Dore ndababwira, nimwubure amaso murebe imirima yuko imaze kwera ngo isarurwe.

36.text: Umusaruzi ahabwe ibihembo, ateranirize imyaka ubugingo buhoraho ngo umubibyi n'umusaruzi banezeranwe,

37.text: kuko iri jambo ari iry'ukuri ngo ‘Habiba umwe, hagasarura undi.’

38.text: Nabatumye gusarura ibyo mutahinze, abandi barakoze namwe mwazunguye umurimo wabo.”

39.text: Nuko benshi mu Basamariya bo muri uwo mudugudu bizera Yesu, kuko bumvise amagambo y'uwo mugore ahamya ati “Yambwiye ibyo nakoze byose.”

40.text: Nuko Abasamariya bamusanze baramwinginga ngo agumane na bo, asibirayo kabiri.

41.text: Hizera abandi benshi baruta aba mbere, kuko biyumviye ijambo rye.

42.text: Maze babwira uwo mugore bati “Noneho si amagambo yawe yonyine aduteye kwizera, kuko natwe twiyumviye tukamenya ko uyu ari we Mukiza w'abari mu isi koko.”

43.text: Iyo minsi ibiri ishize, avayo ajya i Galilaya,

44.text: kuko Yesu yahamije yuko umuhanuzi atagira icyubahiro mu gihugu cy'iwabo.

45.text: Ageze i Galilaya, Abanyagalilaya baramwakira kuko babonye ibyo yakoreye i Yerusalemu byose mu minsi mikuru, kuko muri iyo minsi na bo bari bagiyeyo.

46.text: Bukeye yongera kujya i Kana y'i Galilaya, aho yahinduriye amazi vino. Kandi i Kaperinawumu hariho umutware w'umwami, wari urwaje umwana we w'umuhungu.

47.text: Yumvise yuko Yesu avuye i Yudaya asohoye i Galilaya aramusanga, amwingingira kumanuka ngo akize umwana we kuko yendaga gupfa.

48.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Ntimwakwizera keretse mubonye ibimenyetso n'ibitangaza.”

49.text: Uwo mutware aramusubiza ati “Databuja, manuka akana kanjye katarapfa.”

50.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Genda, umwana wawe ni muzima.”Uwo muntu yizera iryo jambo Yesu amubwiye aragenda.

51.text: Bukeye bwaho akiri mu nzira, abagaragu be baramusanganira baramubwira bati “Umwana wawe ni muzima.”

52.text: Ababaza igihe yoroherewe baramusubiza bati “Ejo ku isaha ndwi, ni ho ubuganga bwamuvuyemo.”

53.text: Nuko se amenya yuko ari yo saha Yesu yamubwiriyemo ati “Umwana wawe ni muzima.” Nuko uwo mutware aramwizera ubwe n'ab'inzu ye bose.

54.text: Icyo ni cyo kimenyetso cya kabiri Yesu yakoze, avuye i Yudaya ageze i Galilaya.
